So this formulation gives strength to the patient.

 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Vajikaranadhikar 1131/66-67 
 Introduction 
 Anagasundar rasa is a classical Ayurvedic formulation. This formulation is helpful in sexual disorders like impotency, Premature ejaculation etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Shuddha Parada: The Pure form of Mercury is used as medicine in various diseases. Parada is silver coloured liquid metal also called Quicksilver.  Parada is a very effective drug.  Other Ingredients Are

 After breaking that soil mixed cloth which becomes hard after getting heat, we get Rasa-sindura. 
 Then do 1 Agastya pushpa bhavna and do frolement for 1 day.

So this formulation gives strength to the patient.
